**Preliminary structuring note:** Exhibits 001/002 and 007/008 appear to be two iterations of the SPA indemnification and privacy disclosure package (the second draft reduces the basket from $7.5M to $4.0M, the cap from $25.0M to $15.0M (10.0% → 7.5% of Base Purchase Price), and the de minimis from $500K to $150K, and updates the incident reference). This Memorandum analyzes both; all redlines in Section 5 are drafted against the **later (Exhibits 007/008) draft**, which is materially less favorable to Buyer and must not be accepted as drafted.
